description:
An interactive storytelling experience where every choice shapes what happens next. Discover cinematic stories across romance, drama, and more, then step inside and become part of the experience.

Watch immersive story episodes, make meaningful decisions, and explore different paths and endings. Chat with characters, build relationships, and continue your journey beyond the story itself.

Save your favorites, follow the worlds you love, and return anytime to see where your choices lead.

If you have any ideas or questions, please email us at support@manna-world.com.

Terms of Service: https://studio.dreem-world.ai/terms
Privacy: https://studio.dreem-world.ai/privacy

reviewSample.text:
I’m giving this AI interactive short story platform a full five stars! I’ve watched countless short dramas and played lots of interactive games, but this combined gameplay style is completely new to me — it’s incredibly refreshing.
What impresses me most is the interactive experience. Besides clicking choices to shift story branches, you can have deep, genuine conversations with AI characters. It perfectly mixes the joy of watching cinematic clips and playing narrative games, keeping me fully immersed without breaking the vibe at all.
The controls are simple and run smoothly, and all storyline

It’s a great app if you like studios like Telltale Games, Quantic Dream and others that create interactive games. Or if you want to feel as if you are inside the movie since now you have a power to interact with the world more and chat with characters from any story. Yes you heard it right if you liked a character in any of the stories you can go and chat with them as if they were alive. 
Happy Dreeming hope to see you soon in the app!

This app isnt only about the character chatting like C.AI but it goes beyond to another level for instance I could watch a story under a world perspective for a character and after that I could move into character chatting where I could share all of my thoughts and life with. More than that all of these characters are so fascinating plussssss I could also create my own ones!!!

This app makes AI short story creation incredibly easy and fun. The interface is user-friendly, the tools are powerful, and the results look surprisingly professional. It saves a lot of time compared with traditional video editing, even for beginners. I’m excited to see how the app continues to improve. Highly recommended!

Only this community is where I feel like home and there is no toxicity and I can easily collaborate w others! I just attended their contest and everyone is so good!!! The team Alex and Annie are especially so helpful!!! I love Dreem! They take in our feedback so well and updates so so fast!

Okay, I'm loving this app. The format feels really new, and the content is actually original and great. It's nothing like those regular short dramas because I get to be the author and change the ending! Honestly, for someone like me who's always having weird little brainwaves, this is just a blast.

I was nervous to try this app at first, but it was so worth it! It’s definitely easier if you have a computer, but you can still use your phone too—it’s just a bit harder to understand & use my friends ☕️
 (I use my phone 😂) 

It’s honestly so much fun watching your story’s come to life. The animations & effects are amazing-wayyy better than so many other apps I’ve tried. & it’s free! 

Anywayyy, idk about ya’ll, but I’ve had a lot of fun hanging out with the lil community, & bringing my ideas to life 🫶 May The Force Be With You 🫡
Love the interactive stories, really immersive and completely got me hooked! I spent hours scrolling through episodes and then more chatting with the characters, it's soo addictive!!!
